title: SuperTruth connectome study results
description: Arms x metrics for viz/results_charts.html. Every value is a number produced by a run, or null (awaiting run). Nothing here is estimated.

generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run that wrote this file

run_manifest.description: path or hash of the run manifest

seeds.description: seeds the mean and 95% CI are taken over

ci.description: how the 95% CI was computed, e.g. 't over seeds' or 'bootstrap 10,000'

teacher.description: reference values for the teacher engine itself, drawn as a line in every panel where they apply

domain.description: fixed axis domain, or null to fit

dimensions.description: for per-dimension metrics: the dimension names, in order

results.description: results[arm_id][metric_id] = { mean, ci_low, ci_high, n } or, for per-dimension metrics, { per_dimension: [ {mean, ci_low, ci_high}, ... ] }

n.description: seeds or records the statistic is over
